// 👉 NHỚ ĐIỀN MẬT KHẨU THẬT VÀO ĐÂY
secret_pass = "nhap_mat_khau_cua_may_vao_day" 

mutable data_sxh = []
mutable data_tcm = []
mutable data_threshold = [] 
mutable data_transmission = []
mutable data_severity = []

{
  async function decryptData(url, password) {
    const response = await fetch("../dashboard/" + url);
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Không tìm thấy: " + url);
    const encryptedBuf = await response.arrayBuffer();
    const keyBuf = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(password));
    const keyBytes = new Uint8Array(keyBuf);
    const dataBytes = new Uint8Array(encryptedBuf);
    for (let i = 0; i < dataBytes.length; i++) dataBytes[i] = dataBytes[i] ^ keyBytes[i % keyBytes.length];
    return JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(dataBytes));
  }

  async function autoLoad() {
    try {
      const [sxh, tcm, thr, trans, sev] = await Promise.all([
        decryptData("sxh.dat", secret_pass), decryptData("tcm.dat", secret_pass),
        decryptData("threshold.dat", secret_pass), decryptData("transmission.dat", secret_pass), decryptData("severity.dat", secret_pass)      
      ]);
      mutable data_sxh = sxh; mutable data_tcm = tcm; mutable data_threshold = thr;
      mutable data_transmission = trans; mutable data_severity = sev;
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Lỗi giải mã: " + e.message);
    }
  }
  autoLoad();
}

```{ojs}
//| output: false
//| echo: false

// ==========================================
// KHỐI TÍNH TOÁN (Đã tách riêng cho an toàn)
// ==========================================
d3 = require("d3")
Highcharts = window.Highcharts

sys_max_yr = d3.max(data_sxh, d => d.Year) || new Date().getFullYear();
sys_max_wk = d3.max(data_sxh.filter(d => d.Year == sys_max_yr), d => d.Week) || 0;

getSmartVal = (dataList, wk, algoName) => {
  const rows = dataList.filter(d => Number(d.Week) === wk);
  if (!rows.length) return null;
  const row = rows[0];
  if (row[algoName] !== undefined) return row[algoName];
  if (row[algoName.toLowerCase()] !== undefined) return row[algoName.toLowerCase()];
  const matchRow = rows.find(r => r.Type === algoName);
  return matchRow ? matchRow.Threshold : null;
};

function countThresholds(disease, ward, yr, wk) {
  let w_data = data_threshold.filter(d => d.Disease === disease && d.NoiOHienTai_SauKhiSapNhap_WardId === ward && d.Year === yr);
  let row = w_data.find(d => d.Week === wk);
  if (!row) return 0;
  let cases = row.cases || 0;
  let far = getSmartVal(w_data, wk, 'Farrington') || 99999;
  let cus = getSmartVal(w_data, wk, 'Cusum') || 99999;
  let cdc = getSmartVal(w_data, wk, 'CDC') || 99999;
  let score = 0;
  if (cases > far) score++;
  if (cases > cus) score++;
  if (cases > cdc) score++;
  return score;
}

function getHotspots(disease) {
  let wards = [...new Set(data_threshold.filter(d => d.Disease === disease && d.NoiOHienTai_SauKhiSapNhap_WardId !== "Toàn Thành phố").map(d => d.NoiOHienTai_SauKhiSapNhap_WardId))];
  let bad_wards = [];
  for(let w of wards) {
     if (countThresholds(disease, w, sys_max_yr, sys_max_wk) >= 2 &&
         countThresholds(disease, w, sys_max_yr, sys_max_wk - 1) >= 2 &&
         countThresholds(disease, w, sys_max_yr, sys_max_wk - 2) >= 2) {
         bad_wards.push(w);
     }
  }
  return bad_wards;
}

function getCityKPI(raw_data, disease) {
  let current = d3.sum(raw_data.filter(d => d.Year === sys_max_yr && d.Week === sys_max_wk), d => d.SoCa) || 0;
  let prev = d3.sum(raw_data.filter(d => d.Year === sys_max_yr && d.Week === sys_max_wk - 1), d => d.SoCa) || 0;
  let pct = prev > 0 ? ((current - prev) / prev * 100).toFixed(1) : 0;
  let trend = current >= prev ? `▲ tăng ${pct}%` : `▼ giảm ${Math.abs(pct)}%`;
  let score = countThresholds(disease, "Toàn Thành phố", sys_max_yr, sys_max_wk);
  let status = score === 0 ? {t: "🟢 BÌNH THƯỜNG", c: "#28a745"} :
               score === 1 ? {t: "🟡 LƯU Ý", c: "#ffc107"} :
               score === 2 ? {t: "🟠 CẢNH BÁO", c: "#fd7e14"} :
                             {t: "🔴 BÁO ĐỘNG", c: "#dc3545"};
  return { current, trend, status };
}

kpi_sxh = getCityKPI(data_sxh, "Sốt xuất huyết")
hotspots_sxh = getHotspots("Sốt xuất huyết")
sev_cases_sxh = d3.sum(data_sxh.filter(d => d.Year === sys_max_yr && d.Week === sys_max_wk && d.NhomDieuTri === "Nội trú"), d => d.SoCa) || 0;

function drawGauge(id, val, maxVal, title, valText) {
  let color = val <= maxVal*0.25 ? '#2ca02c' : 
              val <= maxVal*0.5 ? '#ffc107' : 
              val <= maxVal*0.75 ? '#fd7e14' : 
              val <= maxVal*0.95 ? '#cc0000' : '#800080';

  let container = document.createElement('div');
  container.style = "width:100%; height:200px;";
  setTimeout(() => {
    if(window.Highcharts) {
      Highcharts.chart(container, {
        chart: { type: 'gauge', backgroundColor: 'transparent' },
        title: { text: title, style: { fontSize: '14px', fontWeight: 'bold' } },
        pane: { startAngle: -90, endAngle: 90, center: ['50%', '80%'], size: '120%', background: null },
        yAxis: {
          min: 0, max: maxVal, tickPositions: [], lineWidth: 0,
          plotBands: [
            { from: 0, to: maxVal*0.25, color: '#2ca02c', innerRadius: '70%', outerRadius: '100%' },
            { from: maxVal*0.25, to: maxVal*0.5, color: '#ffc107', innerRadius: '70%', outerRadius: '100%' },
            { from: maxVal*0.5, to: maxVal*0.75, color: '#fd7e14', innerRadius: '70%', outerRadius: '100%' },
            { from: maxVal*0.75, to: maxVal*0.95, color: '#cc0000', innerRadius: '70%', outerRadius: '100%' },
            { from: maxVal*0.95, to: maxVal, color: '#800080', innerRadius: '70%', outerRadius: '100%' }
          ]
        },
        series: [{
          name: 'Chỉ số', data: [val],
          dataLabels: {
            format: `<div style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:1.2rem; font-weight:bold; color:${color}">${valText}</span></div>`,
            useHTML: true, y: 15, borderWidth: 0
          },
          dial: { radius: '80%', backgroundColor: '#333', baseWidth: 6, topWidth: 1, baseLength: '0%' },
          pivot: { backgroundColor: '#333', radius: 6 }
        }],
        tooltip: { enabled: false }, credits: { enabled: false }
      });
    }
  }, 100);
  return container;
}

// Bơm sẵn biểu đồ vào biến để nhét vào giao diện cho gọn
gauge_sev_sxh = drawGauge("gauge-sev-sxh", sev_cases_sxh, 1000, "Mức độ Nặng (Nội trú)", sev_cases_sxh + " ca")
gauge_trans_sxh = drawGauge("gauge-trans-sxh", kpi_sxh.current, 2000, "Mức độ Lây truyền", kpi_sxh.current + " ca")
```
